intervals.label: assembly in the East hall
intervals.note: Assembled in the East hall during the 1994 HERA run; the end bound (1995, year precision) is the first year of data taking; no construction start is stated.
intervals.quote: The experiment was assembled in the East hall outside the shielding during the 1994 HERA run.

intervals.label: data taking
intervals.locator: arXiv:1209.2803, Section on polarised targets; arXiv:1204.4161: "Hermes acquired data from 1995 to 2007"
intervals.note: Year precision; polarised targets until 2005, recoil detector installed in 2006 (talk, not cited); HERA stopped on 30 June 2007 (see accelerator:hera).
intervals.quote: HERMES was operating from 1995 to 2007 at the HERA lepton storage ring

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: End of HERMES data taking coincides with the end of HERA operation in 2007.
intervals.quote: HERMES was operating from 1995 to 2007 at the HERA lepton storage ring

placements.note: Placed at the DESY Hamburg campus site (campus-grade): the East and West halls of the HERA ring have no coordinate in any fetched source (OpenStreetMap names only the North hall and a building "HERA West 50", whose position does not fit the ring geometry), so no hall point is asserted.
placements.quote: The HERMES experiment is located in the East hall of the HERA storage ring complex at DESY.

summary.plain: A forward-angle particle spectrometer built around a spin-polarised gas target inside the HERA storage ring, with tracking chambers, a magnet, particle-identification detectors and calorimetry.
summary.technical: HERMES forward spectrometer: numerous tracking chambers (micro-strip gas chambers, drift and proportional chambers) in front of and behind a 1.3 T m dipole magnet, RICH and calorimetry, internal polarised gas target; a recoil detector was added in 2006.

technology.quote: The spectrometer is a forward angle instrument of conventional design.
technology.value: Forward-angle spectrometer with tracking chambers on either side of a dipole magnet and an internal polarised gas target
